scope: Frozen first CPU prototype. TRAIN replay only. No physical or raw-command qualification.

replay.route_source: saved commands.applied. Channels 1=left, 2=right, 7=exit. External progress-derived simulator pulses are disclosed inputs.
replay.baseline: existing fsop.eval.geometric.midline with its unchanged 25 m range, origin anchor, and one-side behavior; identical decoded detections and shared diagnostic local controller
replay.route_bin_time_semantics: Each pooled history row supplies an interval-end event timestamp. This is not reconstruction of the original 20 Hz raw pulse time.
replay.full_reference: Canonical teacher geometry only after source/array binding and <=1e-10 reproduction on saved teacher controls. Otherwise measured future driven trajectory, with teacher metrics explicitly unverified.

limitations: The pad, braking and response constants are engineering assumptions, not calibrated uncertainty or stopping guarantees.
Orange classes share a lane color. Blue-blue and yellow-yellow gates are forbidden.
Near detections alone cannot establish a boundary. A track needs a 5-10 m support observation within the age limit.
No one-sided boundary extrapolation, inferred circle centers, learned association, or inferred lap counter.
No physical launch, final case, model inference, training, or dependency modification is part of this prototype.
